methods.name: Quest skip to level 37
methods.note: Doric's Quest, The Dig Site, Plague City, The Giant Dwarf, The Lost Tribe and Another Slice of H.A.M. give 27,525 XP, level 1 to 37; Plague City alone reaches 15.

methods.name: Copper and tin
methods.note: Copper or tin at Lumbridge Swamp with a bronze pickaxe, steel from 6, dropping each ore. About 140 ores reach 15, where iron is faster.

methods.name: Iron ore powermining
methods.note: A three-rock triangle, dropping each ore: steel pickaxe to 20, then mithril, adamant and rune. From 60 the members' Mining Guild, dragon pickaxe from 61.

methods.name: Motherlode Mine
methods.note: Mine pay-dirt, wash it and bank the ore: low effort and profitable. Rates assume the upper level from 57, a dragon pickaxe and the prospector kit bought with nuggets.

methods.name: Sandstone
methods.note: Ironmen mine sandstone at the desert quarry and grind it into buckets of sand for Crafting. No guide rates it for Mining XP without tick manipulation.

methods.name: Gem rocks
methods.note: Underground Shilo Village mine with a charged amulet of glory, which triples the chance; a gem sack saves banking. Ironmen come for opals, jades and red topaz.

methods.name: Calcified rocks
methods.note: Cam Torum mine; Perilous Moons started is enough. Low effort, and the blessed bone shards train Prayer, but no mining enhancer gives extra here.

methods.name: Granite (3-tick)
methods.note: Tick-perfect 3-tick cycle at the desert quarry, with heat protection, or Cape Conch: the fastest Mining XP in the game. Very click-intensive; about 63,000 without it.

methods.name: Rubium rocks
methods.note: Charred Dungeon, past red and black dragons, so bring antifire. Splinters stack, two a success from 72, so there is no banking: low effort profit.

methods.name: Crashed stars
methods.note: Find a crashed star and mine it, one click every seven minutes; stardust buys the celestial ring. Lower star tiers work from level 10.

methods.name: Lead rocks
methods.note: Deepfin Mine triangle, dropping each ore. Superior mining gloves (60 Mining, 100 minerals) make each rock give three ores, so mining never waits.

methods.name: Volcanic Mine
methods.note: Fossil Island team minigame, best with 3 to 5 players; bring food and numulite. Dragon pickaxe rates for a steady team; a crystal pickaxe adds about 12%.

methods.name: Zalcano
methods.note: Skilling boss under Prifddinas in XP mode (ask Rhiannon): about 1,100 Mining XP a kill at 48 kills an hour on a busy world. Team size and contribution swing it.

methods.name: Blast Mine
methods.note: Lovakengj solo activity with dynamite, a chisel and a tinderbox, about 330 dynamite an hour. Runite comes from 75; the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary means better ore.

methods.name: Amethyst
methods.note: Mining Guild amethyst, about 75 to 90 an hour with the guild's invisible +7. Very low effort and steady profit; expert mining gloves and Varrock armour 4 help.

unverified: Quest skip to level 37: Doric's Quest 1,300, The Dig Site 15,300, Plague City 2,425, The Giant Dwarf 2,500, The Lost Tribe 3,000 and Another Slice of H.A.M. 3,000 make 27,525, level 37 (Quest experience rewards); the app carries all 16 quests with Mining XP (245,600, with Fallen From Grace's 5,000 that the guide's table leaves out); no hourly rate, so never dealt

Copper and tin: no guide or efficiency table rates them; 85% of non-stop mining from the chart (100/350, 17.5 XP) with a bronze pickaxe to 5 and steel from 6 (8 and 6 ticks a roll): 4,400 at 1, 6,600 at 6, 7,200 at 10

Iron ore powermining: 85% of a simulated three-rock triangle (96/350, rocks back in 9 ticks) with the shop pickaxes, 15,500 at 15 to 42,900 at 55, where the triangle caps it near the Free-to-play guide's 52,500; from 60 the members' Mining Guild (+7 invisible, back in 4 ticks, 100% chance), 59,500 with rune and 63,000 with a dragon pickaxe, 85% of the 70,000 and 74,100 non-stop that the guide's 70,000 to 80,000 brackets; a black pickaxe at 11 would make 15 to 20 about 20% faster

Motherlode Mine: 85% of the Motherlode Mine page's table (upper level from 57, dragon pickaxe from 61, prospector kit when bought), which is 74 to 81% of mining without a break from 40 up by the pay-dirt chart and the cleaning bonus; the guide's 62,000 at 90 became 52,000 in an anonymous edit of 15 October 2026; the Ultimate Ironman Guide's 42,000 at 85 and 53,000 at 99 and Wise Old Man ironman's 45,200 at 85 to 87 sit with the bands from 80, but its 30,000 at 70 is 26% under the 70 band

Sandstone: still no Mining rate without tick manipulation on any guide; Wise Old Man ironman rates only 3-tick sandstone (70,600 at 37 to 53, 72,600 at 54 to 59, 90,200 at 97 to 98); left unrated as an ironman's route to buckets of sand

Gem rocks: 85% of the guide's rough estimates without the prospector kit's 2.5% (33,200 at 40 to 62,200 at 99); the Money making guide's 950 gems an hour (61,750) agrees within 1% at the top; both assume a charged amulet of glory (84/210 against 28/70), which req cannot say; Shilo Village is now in req because the village opens only after the quest

Calcified rocks: 85% of the guide's table (20,000 to 41,700); no row below 50, so the 50 row runs from 41; the Ultimate Ironman Guide's 45,000 at 99 is within 8% of the guide's 49,000; no success chart is published; Perilous Moons only has to be started, which req cannot say

Granite (3-tick): the guide's table as written; rebuilt from the granite cascade with a second roll on a failed first and the guide's gear, tick-perfect at 99 is 134,100 against its stated 134,498, and every row is 93.7% of it within 2%; under Wise Old Man main wherever it rates (106,540 at 63 to 74 up to 126,000 at 99); desert heat protection at the quarry, or Troubled Tortugans started for Cape Conch, cannot go in req

Rubium rocks: no success chart is published; Jagex put active dragon pickaxe mining at 96 at about 63,000 to 75,000 by enhancers (22 May 2026), and 85% of 63,000, 53,600, is used from 97; the page's table (39,000 at 48 to 57,000 at 97) is 9.5% under Jagex there and is scaled by the same ratio below; its 99 row counts the cape and Varrock armour; dragonfire protection cannot go in req

Crashed stars: 85% of non-stop mining from the chart (73/117, 32 XP), rune at 60 and dragon from 61 (21,300 to 26,600); the guide's table, scouting and idle included, is 93 to 96% of non-stop, the Shooting Stars page's 30,000 at 90+ is the non-stop rate, and the Ultimate Ironman Guide's 27,000 is 89% of it

Lead rocks: 85% of non-stop mining at the Deepfin triangle with superior mining gloves (112/278, Mod Ash 44% at 1 and 109% at 99; three ores a rock), 57,300 at 60 to 72,900 from 86; with Varrock armour and a charged ring non-stop is 102,900, the guide's up to 90,000 to 100,000, and the Deepfin money making guide's 1,800 ores an hour banking (72,900) matches; lead rocks also stand in the Pandemonium Cave by a bank, open after Pandemonium, but no page rates powermining there, so req keeps Deepfin Mine's 67 Sailing; the gloves cannot go in req

Volcanic Mine: the guide's dragon column as written (68,000 at 70 to 84,000 at 99, a steady 3 to 5 player team); the Volcanic Mine page repeats it, its 105,000 with boosting accounts is the maximum, and the Ultimate Ironman Guide's 65,000 to 90,000 sit at or above it; open from 50, recommended from 70

Zalcano: the guide gives no representative rate; the Money making guide's XP mode figure, 1,100 Mining XP a kill at 48 kills an hour on a 15 player world (52,800), is used flat from 70; a 2024 talk page note gives about 65,000 at 90 with Varrock armour and a celestial ring

Blast Mine: 85% of 385 dynamite an hour at 245.6 XP a dynamite, from the money making guide's record of 1,000 dynamite at 99 (1.58 ores a dynamite) at today's ore XP and 20 for the excavation: 80,400 at 99, and 61,000, 66,800 and 74,100 at 75, 80 and 90 by Jagex's own curve of January 2016; Jagex's rates plus the 10% of May 2024 are 4.5% under at every level; the guide's 65,000 and 87,000 add the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary's richer ore and the prospector kit; the 1,000 dynamite predate the 2024 rework, whose longer ore timer makes faster patterns possible

Amethyst: 85% of non-stop mining from the chart (-18/10) with the Mining Guild's invisible +7 carried past 99 on the same line, dragon pickaxe: 18,600 at 92 to 21,900 at 99 (77 to 91 an hour); the Ultimate Ironman Guide's 19,900 and 23,500 with Varrock armour 4 are 83% of non-stop with it

Pickaxes and enhancers: every rate from 61 assumes a dragon pickaxe (642,584 coins on 17 October 2026, a rare drop for ironmen), and a rune pickaxe is about 6% slower; no rate counts Varrock armour, a charged celestial ring or the Mining cape, which add 10%, 10% and 5% where they work

Not included: nickel rocks (74, Sailing islands, 2 to 16 ores a rock, no chart or rate anywhere); sunstone (53, Fallen From Grace, mined for golem crafting, no rate); infernal shale (78, A Kingdom Divided, rated only with tick manipulation, 67,000 to 80,000); 3-tick gem rocks (89,000 to 110,000, within 2 to 4% of 3-tick granite where both are open, behind Shilo Village, the medium Karamja Diary and a glory); 3-tick calcified rocks (40,000 to 94,000); rubium deposits (68, 5,000 to 11,000); daeyalt essence (60, about 8,900, mined for Runecraft); barronite (14, Below Ice Mountain, 18,000 to 20,000 at 75 with both charms); rune essence; runite golems
